sources.waitingLostChoose_one: One change in the calendars left out has not reached {{kind}} yet and gets lost. "Done" leaves them out anyway.
sources.waitingLostChoose_other: {{count}} changes in the calendars left out have not reached {{kind}} yet and get lost. "Done" leaves them out anyway.
sources.exists: This account is connected already. Choose its calendars here.
sources.empty: No accounts or subscriptions connected yet. With “Add calendar” you bring in iCloud, Google, other CalDAV servers, subscriptions or holidays.
sources.expiredHint_one: {{kind}} access expired. {{names}} keeps showing the state of {{when}}; changes work again after connecting anew.
sources.expiredHint_other: {{kind}} access expired. {{names}} keep showing the state of {{when}}; changes work again after connecting anew.
sources.eventsOver: You have {{total}} events; from {{limit}} on nextime may get slower.
sources.newCalendars_one: One new calendar is waiting under “Choose calendars”.
sources.newCalendars_other: {{count}} new calendars are waiting under “Choose calendars”.
sources.unreadable_one: One event could not be read.

state.paused: resting while Google is switched off
state.stale: not updated since {{when}}, the last events stay
state.unreachable: not reachable right now, state of {{when}}

googleBack.denied: Without access to the calendars nothing works. Nothing is connected.
googleBack.expired: Signing in at Google took too long. Please connect once more.
googleBack.failed: Google did not confirm the connection. Please try once more.
googleBack.other_account: That was another Google account than the connected one. Sign in with the connected account.
googleBack.exists: This Google account is connected already.

sources.unreachableHint_one: {{kind}} is not reachable right now. {{names}} shows the state of {{when}}.
sources.unreachableHint_other: {{kind}} is not reachable right now. {{names}} show the state of {{when}}.

notice.changed: {{source}} did not take your change to “{{title}}” ({{what}}). The event shows the state from {{source}} again.
notice.deleted: {{source}} did not take deleting “{{title}}”. The event shows the state from {{source}} again.
notice.created: “{{title}}” is now a new event in the calendar.

sources.head: Accounts and subscriptions

whyNot.no_replies: This CalDAV server takes no answers. Answer in the app of your account.
whyNot.locked: Answers work again once the connection under Calendars and accounts stands.
whyNot.read_only_source: No answers go out through a subscription link.
whyNot.by_mail: This invitation came by mail. The answer goes out from your mail app.

invitations.changed: The invitation changed meanwhile. This is how it stands now.
invitations.declined: “{{title}}” declined. The invitation stays in the search.
invitations.deleteText: Without an answer {{name}} does not know that you are not coming.
invitations.seriesTitle: For which events is the answer?

googleSetup.title: Google project
googleSetup.text: Once for the whole server, about 10 minutes. Afterwards every member can read and write Google calendars. Without this set-up Google works read only, through the secret address.
googleSetup.noHttps: nextime is not reached over HTTPS. Google does not connect like this; set up HTTPS first.
googleSetup.moved: The address of nextime has changed. Enter the redirect address at Google anew.

project.title: Create a project
project.text: In the Google Cloud Console, create a new project “nextime”.

api.title: Turn on the Google Calendar API
api.text: Search for it under “APIs & Services” and enable it.

consent.title: Set up the consent screen
consent.text: External, app name nextime, publishing status “In production”, so that grants do not expire after 7 days.

client.title: Create credentials
client.text: An OAuth client ID of the type “Web application”, with the redirect address from below.

values.title: Enter the values here
values.text: Paste client ID and secret; nextime checks them at once.

googleSetup.secretSet: saved; type it anew to change it
googleSetup.warning: If the values change, every member has to connect Google again.

dialog.title: Share “{{name}}”
dialog.onlyYou: Only you decide who sees this calendar. Only you can share it further.
dialog.search: Find a member by name or address
dialog.nobody: Nobody on this server matches. Sharing works with members only; the read link for guests is still possible.

link.title: Read link for guests without an account
link.text: Guests see events, times and places, but no attachments. Subscribe in a calendar or view in the browser.
link.off: The operator switched guest links off.
link.unreadable: After a restored backup the address can no longer be shown; the link still works.

noAccess.icloud: The other person needs no access to your iCloud account for this. They see the calendar in nextime and on their iPhone.
noAccess.google: The other person needs no access to your Google account for this. They see the calendar in nextime and on their iPhone.
noAccess.caldav: The other person needs no access to your CalDAV account for this. They see the calendar in nextime and on their iPhone.

source.busyText: With “busy only”, titles, places and notes stay with you, also in search and notifications.

area.empty: You share nothing, and nobody shares anything with you. Sharing starts with “Share …” in the menu of a calendar.
area.mineNone: You are not sharing anything right now.
area.withMeNone: Nobody is sharing anything with you right now.
area.gone: “{{calendar}}” is no longer there: {{name}} ended the sharing.
area.askLinkText: Guests with the link will no longer see “{{calendar}}”.
area.askLeaveText: The calendar goes from your list. {{name}} can share it with you again.

guest.gone: This link is no longer valid.
guest.stays: Once subscribed, the calendar stays up to date on your device until {{name}} takes the link back.
guest.none: No coming events. You can still subscribe.

notify.heading: {{name}} · Settings
notify.switch: Notify me when others change something here
notify.bundled: Off from the start. Several changes in a row come bundled, after 2 quiet minutes. Your own changes notify nothing.
notify.notShared: Notifications are for calendars you share with others or that are shared with you. Only you see this calendar.
notify.deniedHelp: This browser does not allow notifications. In the lock symbol left of the address, set “Notifications” to “Allow”, then reload the page.
notify.unsupportedHelp: On iPhone and iPad, notifications come only from the installed web app: add nextime with “Share” › “Add to Home Screen” and allow them there.
notify.nowhere: Nothing arrives this way: no device has allowed notifications yet.
notify.noHttps: nextime is not reached over HTTPS. Browsers take notifications only over HTTPS, so nothing arrives.
notify.noInternet: The server does not reach the internet and with it the browsers' notification services. So nothing arrives.
notify.preview: This is how the notification looks
notify.probeSent: The probe is on its way.

reminders.occurrencesKept: Single events of this series have reminders of their own from a device; they stay.

area.deviceHint: Only this browser; your other devices keep reminding.
area.deviceFirst: This browser shows no notifications from nextime yet.
area.notDouble: Not twice when Apple Calendar reminds already
area.notDoubleHint: On an iPhone with the calendar account set up, Apple Calendar reminds by itself; nextime stays quiet there.
area.defaultsText: For events you chose nothing of your own for.
area.preview: This is how the reminder looks
area.noDevice: Nothing arrives this way: no device reminds yet.

places.hint: Suggestions come from a free service; only the place goes out, never the title.

attachments.guests: Whoever may see the calendar sees the attachments too. Guests with the read link do not.
attachments.ownOnly: Attachments are only for events in nextime calendars.
attachments.tooLarge: {{name}} is too large ({{size}}, at most {{max}} MB).
attachments.failed: {{name}}: the upload broke off. The file is still missing.
attachments.removeText: “{{name}}” is then gone for good, not in the trash.
attachments.unavailable: “{{name}}” cannot be fetched right now. It stays in {{source}}.
attachments.proxy: The server takes no files this large. The limit of the reverse proxy is smaller than nextime's.
attachments.runningText: If you close the event without saving, the files still coming will be missing.
attachments.moveLoses_one: Moving it to {{source}} loses the attachment; {{source}} cannot carry any.
attachments.moveLoses_other: Moving it to {{source}} loses the {{count}} attachments; {{source}} cannot carry any.

quick.noDate: No date found. Enter opens the event with “{{text}}” as its title.
quick.tooLong: The title can have at most {{max}} characters (now {{count}}).
quick.endBeforeStart: The end lies before the start. Enter opens the event.
quick.noTitle: No title yet. Enter opens the event.
quick.tagUnknown: “{{tag}}” fits no calendar you can add to; the event goes to {{calendar}}.
quick.tagReadOnly: “{{tag}}” can only be read; the event goes to {{calendar}}.
quick.failed: Not saved: the connection broke off. The text stays, Enter tries again.
quick.noTime: A length without a time. Enter opens the event.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Searches titles, places and notes, past and future. Several words find events with all of them.
search.failed: The search did not work just now. Try again in a moment.

trash.title: Trash
trash.failed: The trash could not be loaded.
trash.nothingHint_one: Deleted events and calendars stay here {{count}} day, then they are gone for good.
trash.nothingHint_other: Deleted events and calendars stay here {{count}} days, then they are gone for good.
trash.calendarGone: calendar deleted since, asks where to
trash.sources: iCloud and Google events you deleted in nextime are created there anew by “Restore”. What was deleted directly in Apple Calendar is not here.

confirmEmpty.title: Empty the trash?
confirmEmpty.text_one: The entry will be gone for good, with its attachments.
confirmEmpty.text_other: The {{count}} entries will be gone for good, with their attachments.

target.title: Where should “{{title}}” go?
target.text: Its calendar has been deleted since.

trash.seriesGone: series in the trash or calendar deleted: restore the series first

reason.source_has_it: now in the calendar from its source

pwa.update: There is a new version of nextime.

install.title: Install on this device
install.text: Installed, nextime starts like an app: in its own window without the browser's bar, with its own icon.
install.asked: The browser asked. If you agreed, you find nextime among your apps.
install.ios: On iPhone and iPad: Share › Add to Home Screen.
install.installed: nextime runs as an installed app on this device already.
install.safari: In Safari on the Mac: File › Add to Dock.
install.firefox: Firefox cannot install web apps. Open nextime in another browser for it, such as Chrome, Edge or Safari.
install.other: If your browser offers no button here, installing is in its menu, such as “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

offline.state: No connection · as of {{when}} · read only
offline.text: The next 4 weeks stay readable. Adding events works again with a connection, or later with the nextime app for iPhone.
offline.textNone: What is on screen stays. Reading without a network works in the installed web app; adding events again with a connection.
offline.outside: This period shows once you are connected.
offline.full: This device has too little free space: nothing stays readable here without a network. With a connection everything works as usual.
offline.searchKept: without a connection only in the 4 weeks kept
offline.panel: No connection, read only. Changes work again with a connection.
offline.notKept: This event is not kept for use without a connection.
offline.plusOff: New event, not possible without a connection
offline.moveOff: Nothing can be moved without a connection.
offline.changeOff: Nothing can be changed without a connection.
offline.settingsOff: Without a connection the settings are read only. Changes work again with a connection.

export.title: Export
export.text: As an ICS file, with series, reminders and places. Readable by every calendar.
export.zipNote: In the ZIP the attachments lie beside the file of their calendar.

load.title: Load a file
load.text: Take an ICS file into one of your own calendars.
load.existing_one: {{count}} is there already and is skipped
load.existing_other: {{count}} are there already and are skipped
load.skipped_one: {{count}} entry is no event and is skipped
load.skipped_other: {{count}} entries are no events and are skipped
load.tooLarge_one: {{count}} attachment is larger than allowed and stays behind
load.tooLarge_other: {{count}} attachments are larger than allowed and stay behind
load.needsCalendar: A file goes into one of your own calendars. Create one first.
load.cp1252: The file was not in UTF-8 and was read as Windows-1252 (Western Europe).
load.shortened_one: {{count}} title or note shortened (at most 200 or 10,000 characters).
load.shortened_other: {{count}} titles or notes shortened (at most 200 or 10,000 characters).

text.icloud: An iCloud calendar becomes a nextime calendar of your own, with its name, color and all events.
text.google: A Google calendar becomes a nextime calendar of your own, with its name, color and all events.

move.none: No iCloud or Google calendar is connected. Connect one first through “Add calendar”.
move.invitationsStay_one: {{count}} invitation is not accepted and stays where it is.
move.invitationsStay_other: {{count}} invitations are not accepted and stay where they are.
move.again: Moved before into “{{name}}”: what is there already is skipped.
move.sharedBefore: The calendar is shared. The share stays with the old calendar.
move.invitationsLeft_one: {{count}} invitation (open, maybe or declined) did not come along; it stays in {{source}}.
move.invitationsLeft_other: {{count}} invitations (open, maybe or declined) did not come along; they stay in {{source}}.
move.stays: In {{source}} everything stays as it is; the old calendar is hidden in nextime now.
move.shared: The old calendar stays shared as it was. The new one is not shared; share it if others should see it.

move.limit_one: You will then have {{count}} event; from {{limit}} on nextime may get slower.
move.limit_other: You will then have {{count}} events; from {{limit}} on nextime may get slower.

columns.hint: Drag or use the arrow keys to change the width; double-click to reset it.

symbols.search: Search symbols, such as shopping or dog

keys.below: API under /api/v1. It never gives out access data for iCloud and Google.

dialog.readHint: Read calendars and events, search, find free times.
dialog.writeHint: Also create, change and move events to the trash.
dialog.mcpWriteHint: An AI tool also reads texts from invitations by other people. Such texts could lead it to make changes; anything deleted then lies in the trash.
dialog.hiddenNote: “All calendars” means all you show. A key reads hidden calendars only when you choose them under “Only these …”.

tasks.unreachable: nextasks cannot be reached right now. The tasks come back as soon as it answers.
tasks.problem: nextasks shows no tasks right now. Settings › Connections says why.
tasks.readOnly: This nextasks key can only read. The task stays open; create a key with read and write access in nextasks.
tasks.gone: This task is no longer in nextasks.
tasks.notArrived: Ticking off “{{title}}” did not reach nextasks.
tasks.offline: Without a connection nothing can be ticked off.
tasks.previewTitle: Comes again: a preview, ticking works on the day it is due
tasks.movedOn: In nextasks the task has moved on by more than one repetition; only this completion is taken back.

section.title: nextasks
section.text: Tasks due in your nextasks stand in Today, Day, Week, Month and the lists; you tick them off right in the calendar.
section.how: To connect: create an API key with read and write access in nextasks under My account › Connections, and enter the address of nextasks and the key here.
section.localOff: If your nextasks runs in the local network, the operator has to allow that first under Settings › Server.
section.shows: shows your tasks and those assigned to you that are due
section.readOnly: The key can only read: tasks show in the calendar, ticking them off does not work.
section.disconnectText: The tasks leave nextime and the key is deleted. In nextasks everything stays as it is.
section.toSwitch: Go to “Connections into the local network”
section.areasHint: An area ticked shows all its lists, later ones too; otherwise single lists. All areas from the start.

deadlines.unreachable: nexpaper cannot be reached right now. The deadlines come back as soon as it answers.
deadlines.problem: nexpaper shows no deadlines right now. Settings › Connections says why.

section.title: nexpaper
section.text: Open deadlines from your nexpaper stand in Today, Day, Week, Month and the lists, to look at only; a click opens the document in nexpaper.
section.how: To connect: create an API token with the right “Read only” in nexpaper under Settings › API, and enter the address of nexpaper and the token here.
section.localOff: If your nexpaper runs in the local network, the operator has to allow that first under Settings › Server.
section.shows: shows the open deadlines of the documents you may edit
section.disconnectText: The deadlines leave nextime and the token is deleted. In nexpaper everything stays as it is.
section.toSwitch: Go to “Connections into the local network”

section.title: Devices
section.text: iPhone, iPad and Mac with the nextime app.
section.disconnectText: From now on the device cannot reach your calendars. To connect it again, scan a new code.

connect.title: Connect iPhone or iPad
connect.step1: Open nextime on the iPhone or iPad.
connect.step2: Tap “Add Server” and scan the code.
connect.step3: Done. Your calendars load, and the sign-in travels to your other devices through your Apple ID.
connect.noCamera: Without a camera: in the app, enter the address

appConnect.title: Connect the nextime app to this account?
appConnect.text: Signed in as {{account}}. The app gets the same rights you have in the browser.
appConnect.invalid: The nextime app opens this page itself. Start connecting in the app.
